name: cond_arrow
note: FUN_141FC1380's inverse map (docs/re/pes-re-condition-bands.md section 2): band in R8D (0..7, masked &7 at the call sites 0x141FE397B/0x141FE4108) to PES arrow index in EBX/EAX (0 Top..4 Terrible). The function also stores the arrow through FUN_1408C7710 ([RCX+0x58]); the spec stubs that store and checks EAX (== EBX at every return). Registers: R8D carries the band in; EAX carries the arrow out.

obj.note: the provider object the stubbed store writes +0x58 to
